WITH advisory_lock AS (
            SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(
                hashtext(($1::uuid)::text),
                hashtext(($2::uuid)::text)
            )
         )
         INSERT INTO seller_profile_document_extractions (
             document_id,
             profile_id,
             status,
             extracted_fields
         )
         SELECT
             $1,
             $2,
             'PENDING'::seller_profile_extraction_status,
             '{}'::jsonb
         FROM advisory_lock
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
             FROM seller_profile_document_extractions
             WHERE document_id = $1::uuid
               AND profile_id = $2::uuid
         )
